purpose: Pre-flight smoke and go/no-go for SAEA-E22-DEV-ESB-SHAPE-C-V1, on the SAME four rows the A/B smoke used, so the shape's four reads are directly comparable to two already-sealed sets. Four reads, in order of importance: (1) does the frozen core answer AT ALL with no system message -- a chat template rendered without a system block is a shape this repository has never sent through a flight, and a refusal, an empty completion or a template error must be found on four rows rather than on 6,038; (2) what is arm C's text envelope in tokens, measured, against the 23 tokens arm B measured and the 49 arm A measured, so the window fit rests on a measurement; (3) do both ESB scorers score arm C's sealed manifest through core.scoring_batch with verified true; (4) a wall-time reading for the flight's projection. The smoke's own WER numbers are on four rows and enter no verdict.

E22-ESB-DEV-SMOKE-4.selection: not re-drawn: EXACTLY the four rows the 2026-09-05 A/B smoke flew (longest, shortest, median, p90 by duration, ties broken by sample id), so arm C's four reads sit beside arm A's and arm B's on the same audio

cells.serving_geometry: -c 40960 -np 8, 5120 tokens per slot -- identical to the flight and to the A/B smoke
cells.factor: none; this is arm C's own protocol on four rows

shared_protocol.audio_path: raw audio, bf16 mmproj resident on the GPU, no feature cache directory
shared_protocol.obs: none -- an ESB utterance IS the request
shared_protocol.prompt_shape: [{role: user, content: [input_audio, {type: text, text: 'Transcribe the English audio into text.'}]}] -- NO system message
shared_protocol.instruction: Transcribe the English audio into text.

evaluation.paper_facing_aggregation: corpus: total S+D+I over total reference words
metrics: whether a non-empty completion comes back on every row with no system message
prompt tokens per request (the text envelope), against arm A's measured 49 and arm B's measured 23
peak VRAM and any CUDA fault or out-of-memory
whether both ESB scorers returned per-sample rows through core.scoring_batch with verified = true

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: 4 rows x 1 contact = 4, plus headroom; the registered ceiling is 40.
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 96.959875 s for one pass, rounded to 120; the registered ceiling is 240.
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: 0.5, essentially all of it model load; the registered ceiling is 1.0

decision.go_no_go: The flight launches only if all four reads are affirmative: every one of the four rows returns a non-empty completion under the no-system-message shape; the measured worst prompt plus 1024 completion tokens is at most half the 5120-token slot; both ESB scorers return per-sample rows on the sealed manifest through core.scoring_batch with verified = true; and the projected flight time is at or under the registered ceiling.
decision.claim_surface: none; a smoke's numbers enter no verdict
